description:
Music trivia for fans who know the records.

Pick your crates, from Classic Rock and Southern Rock to Motown, metal, pop and more. All 18 crates are free to play. No account required.

FREE EVERY DAY
• Today's Mix: ten questions from your crates.
• One round a day of each game below.
• Today's story and the cover of the day.
• On This Day in music history.
• Live: find touring artists and music venues near you.

THE GAMES
• Name That Tune: recognize the recording from a short preview.
• Who Did It First?: identify the original artist behind a famous cover.
• Which Came First?: pick the older record.
• The Hard Ones: the toughest questions in your crates.

DEEP CUTS+ (PURCHASE REQUIRED)
These features require a Deep Cuts+ subscription or the Lifetime in-app purchase:
• Unlimited rounds of every game, beyond the free round each day.
• Every story in the app, from studio sessions to concerts, beyond today's free story.

Deep Cuts+ is offered as a monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscription, each starting with a 7-day free trial for eligible accounts, or as a one-time Lifetime purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
